name: YouTube
title: Clip a YouTube video and share just that part — free, no account
h1: Share part of a YouTube video
description: Make a YouTube link with a start AND an end time. Paste the video, mark the moment, share one link that plays only that part and stops when it ends. Works with Shorts. Free, no download, no account.
intro: YouTube's own timestamp link (the ?t= one) starts at the right place and then keeps going. YouTube Clips are creator-gated and capped at 60 seconds. ClippYT gives any YouTube video a link with a start and an end, at any length, and it plays through YouTube's official player so the creator keeps the view.
faq: Can I clip a YouTube Short?
Yes. Paste the Shorts link like any other; the clip page plays it in the normal player.
Does the creator still get the view?
Yes. ClippYT never copies or re-uploads video. Your link opens the original video in YouTube's embedded player, jumped to your start and stopped at your end.
Is there a length limit?
No. Three seconds or thirty minutes, you decide. YouTube's built-in Clips stop at 60 seconds.
Do I need an account?
No. Make and share clips anonymously; an account only adds a library and playlists.

name: Vimeo
title: Clip a Vimeo video — share a start-to-end moment with one link
h1: Share part of a Vimeo video
description: Vimeo has no clip or timestamp-range links. Paste any public Vimeo video into ClippYT, mark a start and an end, and share a link that plays exactly that moment and stops. Free, no download.
intro: Vimeo lets you link to a time (#t=) but nothing stops the video afterwards, and there's no built-in way to share a range. ClippYT plays your moment through Vimeo's official player and stops at your end handle, on any device.
faq: Which Vimeo videos work?
Any public or unlisted video that allows embedding. Private videos that block embeds can't be played by anyone, so they can't be clipped.
Does it work on mobile?
Yes. The clip link opens a page that autoplays your moment (muted, tap for sound) in Vimeo's player.
Is anything downloaded or re-uploaded?
No. Only the link and your two timestamps are stored.

name: Twitch
title: Clip a Twitch VOD moment of any length and share the link
h1: Share part of a Twitch VOD
description: Twitch clips are capped at 60 seconds and must be made live. Paste a Twitch VOD into ClippYT, mark any start and end, and share one link that plays just that part. Free, no download.
intro: Twitch's own clips are short and tied to the moment they're made. For a VOD you already have, ClippYT gives you a link with a start and an end of any length, played through the official Twitch player.
faq: Can I clip a live stream?
Not yet. Paste the VOD once the stream is over; live clipping is on the roadmap.
Is there a length limit?
No. Twitch's built-in clips stop at 60 seconds; ClippYT clips can be any length.
Does the streamer keep the view?
Yes. The VOD plays in Twitch's embedded player, not a copy.
